UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile information and role within the BalanceHub application, separate from authentication credentials managed by an external system (e.g., Firebase Auth).

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity, typically corresponding to the user's Firebase Authentication UID.

email.description: The user's email address, primarily used for identification and display.

displayName.description: The user's public display name, used for recognition within groups and debts.

role.description: The user's role within the application (e.g., 'admin', 'user'), used for access control and permissions.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: Represents a debt group where users can collectively manage and track shared financial obligations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Group entity.

name.description: The descriptive name of the debt group (e.g., 'Pago Agua Mayo').

type.description: The type of the group, indicating how debts are structured (e.g., 'fixed', 'variable').

fixedAmount.description: The default amount to be charged to all members in a 'fixed' type group.

adminId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who is designated as the administrator of this group.

inviteLink.description: A unique, shareable URI used to invite new members to join the group.

memberIds.description: An array of UserProfile IDs representing all members participating in this group.

Debt.title: Debt
Debt.description: Represents an individual debt record within a specific group.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Debt entity.

groupId.description: Reference to the Group this debt belongs to.

debtorId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owes this debt.

amount.description: The monetary amount of the debt.

status.description: The current status of the debt (e.g., 'pending', 'under_review', 'paid').

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The unique identifier for the debt group.

definition.description: Stores individual debt records nested under their group.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent debt group.

params.name: debtId
params.description: The unique identifier for the specific debt record.
